text:
alex: Heads-up — proposing a small cross-team schema for continuous queueing observability so console + runtime + infra all have a single source of truth. want to capture: batch_size distribution, queue_wait_ms (p50/p95/p99), fill_rate (ratio requests in batch vs capacity), dispatcher_saturation (0..1), and a backpressure_flag. thoughts?

priya: love this. can you define the metric names + labels? runtime needs exact names to instrument the batcher.

alex: rough draft names: `redwood_batch_size_hist` (le histogram), `redwood_batch_wait_ms` (histogram with quantiles), `redwood_fill_rate` (gauge 0..1), `redwood_dispatcher_saturation` (gauge 0..1), `redwood_backpressure{level}` (gauge/int). labels: `model`, `deployment`, `zone`, `route`, `priority_tier`.

mike: quick flag — infra exporter currently drops high-card labels. `route` can explode. can we keep `route` optional or sampled?

alex: totally. propose `route` only for canary rollouts and sampled traces. default dashboards aggregate by `model`+`deployment`.

jamie: for console UX: product wants a single panel showing health summary + clickthrough to distributions. summary should show: current median wait, p95 wait, avg batch size, fill_rate, and a saturation traffic light (green/yellow/red). thresholds configurable per deployment.

priya: runtime: also want exemplar traces for p99 waits so we can attach request ids. prometheus exemplars would be ideal.

mike: exemplars are annoying at scale. maybe only send exemplars when `redwood_dispatcher_saturation>0.8` OR when `redwood_batch_wait_ms` p99 > X. reduces overhead.

alex: agreed. rule: exemplars allowed when saturation>0.8 OR p99 wait > 500ms. we'll document the threshold.

jamie: alerting: default alert if `dispatcher_saturation>0.9` for 1m OR p95 wait > 750ms for 5m. ok? we can expose a per-deployment override in console.

priya: one more: we need a fill-rate histogram not just a gauge. workload patterns vary — a 0.6 average could be from steady 0.6 or bursty 1.0/0.0. histogram helps tuning batching window.

alex: good call. add `redwood_fill_rate_hist` (buckets 0,0.1,...1.0).

mike: infra note: histogram cardinality + bucket number impacts TSDB cost. recommend coarse buckets (0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1) initially. we can refine if product needs finer granularity.

jamie: UX-wise, show both summary + a small heatmap for fill-rate distribution to indicate burstiness. product will also want an auto-suggest for batch window changes based on fill-rate trend.

priya: instrumentation TODOs for runtime team: (1) emit names above; (2) attach `exemplar` trace ids on p99 samples; (3) sample `route` label for <=1% of requests unless canary flag set. i'll open PR after we agree.

alex: rollout plan: 1) instrument metrics in staging with coarse buckets, 2) create a dashboard prototype in console using aggregated labels, 3) enable exemplars + sampled route in a small canary, 4) iterate thresholds with SRE before global rollout.

mike: can infra provide a templated ingest rule to map `route` label into an aggregated `route_group` tag to reduce cardinality? would help console drilldowns.

alex: yes — infra: map route -> route_group via prefix rules. fallback `unknown`. we should include mapping mapping doc.

jamie: doc/UX ask: add a one-click 'investigate' that opens a pinned query linking dashboard to traces/alerts when p95>threshold. reduces triage time.

sre-bot: [incident-bot] FYI — new alert rule proposal requires SLO review. Please file a change request PR in `infra-alerts` repo.

priya: ack. i'll file PR for metric names + sampling rules and link the dashboard proto once it's up.

alex: thanks all. i'll draft the telemetry contract + a short sample prometheus yaml snippet in the PR. here's the snippet i'll include:```yaml
# prometheus exporter instrumentation example
- metric: redwood_batch_size_hist
  type: histogram
  labels: [model, deployment, zone, priority_tier]
- metric: redwood_batch_wait_ms
  type: histogram
  buckets: [10,50,100,250,500,1000]
  labels: [model, deployment, zone]
- metric: redwood_fill_rate
  type: gauge
  labels: [model, deployment]
- metric: redwood_dispatcher_saturation
  type: gauge
  labels: [model, deployment, zone]
```

mike: looks fine. just drop the `route` label in these examples to start. keep route sampling config in runtime's README.

jamie: agree. once PR is up i'll prototype the console panels. we should sync next wednesday 9am PT to review dashboard and alerting thresholds.

alex: scheduled — thanks everyone :thumbsup: 

sre-bot: [reminder] sync wednesday @9:00 PT added to #eng-platform calendar.
